value.assistant_ward_theme: Almost every firing Assistant-ward feature is a piece of explanatory, service-register syntax: 'based on', 'I can provide', 'to give you the best possible', 'I need a little more information', 'several/a variety of', 'the goal is to', 'it highlights/speaks to', 'X is crucial for', markdown '### Heading\n\n' openers, and adjective slots in 'That's a remarkably insightful ...' or 'paints a vivid picture'. They fire on function words inside assistant-style sentences rather than on any single lexical marker of the persona, so clamping them removes fragments of the Gemma phrasing rather than the register itself.
value.bella_ward_theme: The firing Bella-ward features are lowercase, informal, spoken-style syntax: sentence-initial 'huh/ugh/nah/yeah', 'gonna', "don't", bare imperatives ('deal with it', 'figure out'), clause-joining commas in run-on speech, lowercase 'i'/'it' sentence starts, and 'today/every day'. Feature 78793 (the one the atlas says the fine-tune increased) fires on contractions and 'gonna' in first-person casual speech.
value.non_firing: 9 of the 25 top Assistant-ward and 7 of the 25 top Bella-ward features fire on fewer than 60 of the 1,300 replies' tokens (several on 0 to 3), so their decoder-column alignment with the direction is not accompanied by any usable activation on chat text; they cannot carry the register in practice and are labelled 'thin evidence'.
